column1: # Measured wall seconds of one package under `go test` in the go-quality test leg (CHAOS-10355), the weight ci/go_race_shard.awk
# balances the three test shards by (`check_go.sh ci-leg test K 3`). HEAVY packages only (20 s and up, main run 39424528475, 350
# packages, ~3,030 s package time in sum): a package with no row weighs 1. The weights only need to be roughly right: a wrong one
# costs balance, never coverage (the shards always partition `go list ./...`). Key = import path relative to the module root.
# Sorted (LC_ALL=C), no duplicates; internal/cigates/testshard checks each row names a real package.
